# HMG Global Business Solutions SARL

> Djibouti-based B2B trade, end-to-end logistics, international sourcing & trading, and business setup consulting partner serving Djibouti and the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor.

HMG Global Business Solutions SARL provides integrated import/export freight, port operations, corridor road haulage, industrial product sourcing (steel, cement, aggregates, industrial supplies), and company implantation consulting in Djibouti.

## Canonical Pages

- [Accueil](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/): Overview of HMG Global Business Solutions’ three business poles, 5-step operational workflow, and cargo types handled in Djibouti and on the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor.
- [Logistique & Transport](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/logistique): End-to-end maritime freight, air freight, road transport, transit formalities, port operations, loading/unloading, handling, warehousing, distribution, and vehicle/equipment transport.
- [Sourcing & Négoce](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/sourcing): Supplier sourcing, manufacturer selection, commercial negotiation (CIF, CFR, FOB, Djibouti reception), steel products, cement, aggregates, industrial drums, tools, and parts.
- [Conseil & Accompagnement](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/conseil): Business setup preparation, administrative filing support, operational organization (premises and supply), business development, and project follow-up in Djibouti.
- [Guides opérationnels](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/guides): Practical B2B reference guide covering Port of Djibouti arrival documents, container/bulk/breakbulk selection, FOB/CFR/CIF/Djibouti delivery Incoterms comparison, steel & cement specs, and 5-step company launch checklist.
- [À propos](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/a-propos): Company mission, Djibouti base, and core commitments (écoute, réactivité, clarté, suivi).
- [Contact & Devis](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/contact): Guided multi-need quote request form for Logistics, Sourcing, or Consulting and direct WhatsApp/email contact details.
- [Mentions légales](https://hmgglobalgroup.com/mentions-legales): Legal notice, corporate details, regulated customs/transit partner disclosure, and intellectual property terms.
